name: to.rovn/healthcare-ops-mcp
title: Rōvn Healthcare Operations MCP
description: Zero-auth CMS Medicare revalidation, NPPES, 15-state boards, NLC, OIG, and SNF ops tools.

tools.name: lookup_medicare_revalidation
tools.description: Look up live CMS November 2026 Medicare revalidation due dates, enrollment IDs, specialties, and group reassignment status by 10-digit NPI (public federal dataset, zero PHI).

tools.name: lookup_nppes_provider
tools.description: Look up public CMS NPPES v2.1 legal name, alternate names, primary taxonomy, practice state, and matching state Medicaid exclusion links by 10-digit NPI.

tools.name: get_state_licensing_board
tools.description: Return official RN/LPN licensing board, CNA nurse aide registry, Nurse Licensure Compact (NLC) status, and Rōvn verification guides for a U.S. state across 15 covered states (GA, FL, TX, OH, NC, PA, VA, CA, NY, IL, MI, NJ, MA, TN, AZ).

state.description: Two-letter U.S. state code (e.g. TX, GA, CA) or full state name, or "ALL".

tools.name: compare_credentialing_platforms
tools.description: Compare Medallion, Verifiable, CertifyOS, Assured, symplr, and Rōvn using dated November 2026 public product documentation across record ownership, SNF/CNA scope, and offer-to-shift workflow.

segment.description: Optional focus filter: all, medical_groups, nursing_homes, api_psv, enterprise_hospitals.

tools.name: ask_rovn_healthcare_ops
tools.description: Search Rōvn’s public healthcare credentialing guides, 15-state RN/CNA boards, CMS Medicare revalidation study, and 2026 vendor comparisons with deterministic grounded links.

query.description: Healthcare credentialing, licensing, onboarding, or CMS question.

limit.description: Optional maximum number of page results (1 to 15, default 6).

tools.name: estimate_delayed_start_cost
tools.description: Calculate delayed-start agency premium and delayed-billing exposure strictly from caller-supplied hiring counts, delayed days, and rate inputs (pure transparent math matching /organizations/roi/methodology).

delayed_days.description: Delayed days between signed offer and first shift (1 to 365).

open_hires.description: Number of hires affected (1 to 500, default 1).

agency_hourly_rate_usd.description: Optional temporary agency hourly bill rate in USD.

employed_loaded_hourly_rate_usd.description: Optional fully loaded direct-hire hourly rate in USD.

hours_per_week.description: Optional clinical hours per week (1 to 80, default 36).

daily_unbilled_revenue_usd.description: Optional delayed daily net clinical revenue per delayed hire in USD.

tools.name: check_nlc_compact_status
tools.description: Check Nurse Licensure Compact (NLC) multistate eligibility between a nurse home state and optional target work state, flagging non-compact states requiring licensure by endorsement.

home_state.description: Two-letter U.S. state code for primary state of residence (e.g. TX, GA, CA).

work_state.description: Optional target two-letter U.S. work state code (e.g. FL, NY).

tools.name: get_oig_exclusion_checklist
tools.description: Return structured federal HHS OIG LEIE, SAM.gov, and state Medicaid exclusion screening steps and verification boundaries for healthcare employers.

state.description: Optional two-letter U.S. state code (e.g. TX, NY, FL) for state Medicaid exclusion notes.

tools.name: get_snf_onboarding_checklist
tools.description: Return the 4-track parallel skilled nursing facility (SNF) onboarding checklist separating portable clinician-owned items from employer-fresh checks under 42 CFR 483.12 and 483.156.

role.description: Role track: cna, lpn, rn, or md_app.

state.description: Optional two-letter U.S. state code for state board and CNA registry links.

tools.name: get_healthcare_ai_benchmarks
tools.description: Return dated 2025 to November 2026 primary-source healthcare AI adoption, ROI hurdle, RN turnover, physician contract-to-start, and CMS Medicare revalidation benchmarks.
